Server %1$s

"Connect" opens this server in OpenVPN for Android. Import it there, then tap it to connect.

If asked for a login, the username and password are both: vpn
Connecting uses the free, open-source \"OpenVPN for Android\" app. Install it, then come back and tap Connect again.

Servers come from VPN Gate (vpngate.net), a free public VPN research project at the University of Tsukuba, Japan. Servers are run by volunteers, so they come and go — refresh to get the latest list.

1. Tap a server and choose Connect.
2. In OpenVPN for Android, import the profile.
3. Tap the profile to connect and accept the VPN request.

If a server doesn't connect, just try another one.

Privacy note: volunteer servers can see your unencrypted traffic and VPN Gate keeps connection logs, so use HTTPS sites and avoid sensitive activity.
